name: Bear Robotics Kinisi (formerly Kinisi KR1)
summary: A wheeled humanoid for picking, placing and sorting boxes and totes, taken over by Bear Robotics with Kinisi Robotics in 2026; key specs are still "to be confirmed at launch".

germany.statusNote: Not launched: Bear lists payload, reach and base as "to be confirmed at launch" and offers pilots through a sales contact form. No European seller or price for Kinisi.

notes: Payload and reach are "to be confirmed at launch".
End effector type is not stated; recorded as gripper from the product rendering.
Operating environment: indoor commercial, logistics and industrial sites.

images.alt: Rendering of Kinisi wheeled humanoids picking boxes in a warehouse aisle

evidence.task: Sort glass by shape, size and material
evidence.note: Bear says Kinisi is already sorting glass in live deployments; customer not named.

evidence.task: Pick, place, sort and kit boxes, bins and totes from shelves, conveyors or the floor
